ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a wedding with {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Engaged colonists want to get married. The ceremony happens on its own once there's somewhere suitable and a calm day; a marriage spot helps.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I want to get married. Properly. With everyone there.
We've been engaged long enough. Let's have a wedding before something else happens.
[afterraid] After today, I don't want to wait any longer to marry {OTHER_nameDef}.
[spring] Spring's a good time for a wedding. Everything's starting over.
[winter] A winter wedding. Everyone in their warmest clothes. I can picture it.

warm.li: I want to stand up in front of all of you and promise {OTHER_nameDef} the rest of my life.

blunt.li: We're getting married. Somebody make it happen.

cheerful.li: A wedding! Flowers! Speeches! Somebody crying in the corner! I can't wait!

gloomy.li: Out here, you never know how long you've got. I'd rather be married when it ends.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I wish to formalize the arrangement.

plain.li: Married. Actually married. Out here, of all places.
[spring] Best day I've had since we landed.

cheerful.li: I'm MARRIED! Did everyone see? Did everyone see?!

plain.li: We'll keep waiting, then. We're good at waiting.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A birthday is coming. A fine meal, a lavish one, or a party would make it a day to remember.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} eats a fine or lavish meal, eats in an impressive dining room, or attends a party in the next few days.

plain.li: It's my birthday soon. I'm not asking for much. A good meal. Maybe a little celebration.
Another year older out here. That's worth something, isn't it? A proper meal, at least.
[old] At my age every birthday is a small miracle. Let's eat well.
[child] It's my BIRTHDAY! Can we have a party? Please? Everyone has to come!
[winter] Born in the middle of winter. Always cold, always hungry. Make this one different.
[lowmood] I'd like one day this season that feels good. My birthday would do.

warm.li: I don't need presents. Just everyone together, and something nice to eat.

blunt.li: Birthday. Feast. You know what to do.

cheerful.li: Guess whose birthday it is! Mine! Party! Cake! Or whatever passes for cake out here!

gloomy.li: Another year gone. Might as well mark it with something better than paste.

cold.li: My birthday approaches. A celebratory meal would be appropriate.

plain.li: Best birthday in years. Maybe ever.
[old] I'll remember this one. Hopefully.

cheerful.li: Thank you, thank you, thank you! I'm doing this again next year!

plain.li: Just another day, then.
[child] Nobody even remembered.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: art for their bedroom
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A sculpture or other piece of art in their own room: something beautiful to wake up to.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A piece of art stands in {PAWN_nameDef}'s bedroom.

plain.li: I'd like something beautiful in my room. A sculpture. Anything that isn't a wall.
[skill:Artistic] I make art all day for everyone else. I'd like one piece for me.
[trait:Greedy] A room without art is just a box with a bed in it.
[rich] We've got sculptures in the storeroom gathering dust. One of them could gather dust in my room.

warm.li: Something small and lovely to look at in the morning. It would mean so much.

blunt.li: My walls are ugly. Fix that.

cheerful.li: Art! In my room! I'll name it and talk to it every morning!

gloomy.li: I'd like one beautiful thing in my life. It might as well be in my room.

cold.li: Art increases room impressiveness. I would like mine increased.

plain.li: I keep looking at it. I'm going to be late to everything now.

cheerful.li: I named it! It's called Gerald!

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: more time to rest
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: More recreation hours in their schedule. Tired people work badly; rested people work well.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef}'s schedule has at least {TARGET} hours of recreation.

plain.li: I haven't had a moment to myself in days. A few hours off. That's all.
Work, sleep, work. I need something in between.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I know. I know. Just let me have an afternoon.
[winter] Long winter. I'd like to spend a little of it not working.
[afterraid] We just survived another attack. Let me breathe for an hour.

warm.li: I'll work harder afterwards, I promise. I just need a little rest.

blunt.li: I'm tired. Give me time off or watch me fall asleep on the job.

cheerful.li: A whole afternoon of doing nothing! Wouldn't that be lovely?

gloomy.li: I'm running on empty. Something's going to give.

cold.li: Productivity declines without rest. I am requesting rest.

plain.li: Time to myself. I forgot what that felt like.

cheerful.li: Free time! I'm going to waste it magnificently.

plain.li: Back to it, then. As always.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a little something
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Colonists with a taste for chemicals want some beer, smokeleaf or similar in stock. Handle with care.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has at least {TARGET} social drugs (beer, smokeleaf joints and the like) in stock.

plain.li: We're out of anything to drink. Or smoke. Or anything at all, really.
A barrel of something. For morale. Mostly mine.
[afterraid] After a day like today, a drink isn't a luxury.
[winter] Long cold nights with nothing to take the edge off. Please.

warm.li: Just a little something to share around the fire. That's all.

blunt.li: I need a drink. The colony needs a drink. Make drinks.

cheerful.li: Who's up for brewing? I'll help! I'll help drink it, mostly!

gloomy.li: Everything's easier with a drink. Not better. Easier.

cold.li: Recreational substances reduce stress. Ours are depleted.

plain.li: Ah. Now that's more like it.

cheerful.li: To the brewers! And the growers! And me!

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} joining the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist has taken a liking to a prisoner and wants them to become one of you.

plain.li: I've been talking with {OTHER_nameDef}. They're not so different from us. Let's bring them in.
{OTHER_nameDef} could be one of us. We could use the hands, and I could use the company.
[small] There are only a few of us. {OTHER_nameDef} would make a difference.

warm.li: Everyone deserves a second chance. Let's give {OTHER_nameDef} one.

blunt.li: Recruit {OTHER_nameDef} already. Stop wasting good food on a prisoner.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me the funniest story through the bars. We need more people like that!

gloomy.li: We need everyone we can get. Even someone who shot at us last week.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has useful skills. Recruitment is the efficient outcome.

plain.li: Welcome, {OTHER_nameDef}. Told you they'd fit in.
I suppose {OTHER_nameDef} stays where they are.
